definitions.gloss: train station bento; boxed meal sold at train stations
definitions.explanation: A type of bento sold at train stations, often featuring local specialties of the region.

examples.japanese: {駅弁|えきべん}を{買|か}って{新幹線|しんかんせん}に{乗|の}った。
examples.english: I bought an ekiben and got on the shinkansen.

examples.japanese: この{地方|ちほう}の{駅弁|えきべん}は{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
{駅弁|えきべん}{大会|たいかい}で{全国|ぜんこく}の{名物|めいぶつ}{弁当|べんとう}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Regional specialty bentos from across the country gathered at the ekiben festival.

notes:
{駅弁|えきべん} is a beloved part of Japanese train travel culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駅弁|えきべん}を{買|か}う (to buy an ekiben)
- {駅弁|えきべん}{大会|たいかい} (ekiben festival/fair)
- ご{当地|とうち}{駅弁|えきべん} (local specialty ekiben)

USAGE NOTES:
- Each region has its own specialty ekiben
- Popular activity to try different ekiben while traveling
- Department stores hold ekiben festivals

RELATED TERMS:
- {弁当|べんとう}: bento, boxed lunch
- {空弁|そらべん}: airport bento
